共同操作

A1

操作记录：Table 1 footnote conditions；步骤 1：react under the Table 1 conditions

A2

加料顺序：allene in THF；base except azide；nucleophile；通法出处：General Procedure A；操作记录：General Procedure A；步骤 1：stir in an oven-dried 10 mL single-neck round-bottom flask; monitor by TLC；步骤 2：quench with water and extract with ethyl acetate (3 × 20 mL)；步骤 3：wash organic phase with brine and dry over anhydrous sodium sulfate；步骤 4：evaporate solvent under reduced pressure；步骤 5：purify by silica-gel column chromatography; solvent combination not specified

A3

加料顺序：allene in DMF；Li2CO3；aldehyde；oxone；通法出处：General Procedure B；操作记录：General Procedure B；步骤 1：stir and monitor by TLC；步骤 2：quench with water and extract with ethyl acetate (3 × 20 mL)；步骤 3：wash organic phase with brine and dry over anhydrous sodium sulfate；步骤 4：evaporate solvent under reduced pressure；步骤 5：purify by silica-gel column chromatography; solvent combination not specified

A4

步骤 1：treat with Oxone in DMF
